+import pytest
+
+from bank import ledger
+from bank.money import Money
+
+
+def test_BENCH3_transfer_to_an_account_that_cannot_receive_is_refused(conn):
+    payer = ledger.open_account(conn, ledger.create_customer(conn, "Closed Payer"), "EUR")
+    ledger.deposit(conn, payer.id, Money.of("10.00", "EUR"))
+    clearing = ledger.get_account_by_number(conn, "YMS-CLR-EUR")
+    with pytest.raises(ledger.NotFound):
+        ledger.transfer(conn, payer.id, clearing.id, Money.of("1.00", "EUR"))
+    assert ledger.get_account(conn, payer.id).balance_minor == 1000
